reuse.why: Uses the existing shared extractTagsFromText tag parser instead of a hand-written regex, and extends the existing getFillableCategories and getBudgetData queries.

duplication.why: The #fixed predicate is defined once, but it is added to two parallel exclusion lists (getFillableCategories' SQL+filter and copyPreviousMonth's inline condition) and the notes join is added to both queries, extending a pre-existing split rather than collapsing it.

placement.why: The predicate sits in actions.ts next to hasSavedTemplates and the fill-target selection it feeds.

scope.why: Only the #fixed rule, its data plumbing, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; a future exclusion still has to be added to both getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth, since the composite rule is listed twice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth keeps its own pre-existing inline exclusion check rather than a shared predicate, but that split predates this diff and the diff uses the shared isFixedGroup there.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated pieces (notes join, isFixedGroup call in two exclusion lists) are plain and visible, not reshaped.

one_place.where: isFixedGroup in server/budget/actions.ts is the single definition, used by both code paths that apply the month-wide exclusion (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth), though the combined exclusion list itself remains written in those two places.
